claims.text: MCP call-actor returns run and storage metadata; output needs a dataset read.
The asynchronous Actor start returns before completion; numbered builds and run limits are available.
maxItems caps charged results for pay-per-result Actors and does not guarantee an output count.
API docs describe a total-cost cap across pricing models; installed MCP schema uses narrower pay-per-event wording.
Public monthly Starter quote was USD 19 with USD 19 prepaid usage and USD 0.20 per CU on 2026-11-13.
Inspected RAG Web Browser BRONZE event quotes were fetched page USD 0.0019, search result USD 0.0029 and start USD 0.000225 per GB, minimum one event.
Hypothetical 10 fetched-page events plus one one-GB start event total USD 0.019225 in event charges; no live total inferred.
Completion responses can have preliminary cost figures; authenticated reinspection is needed.
Limited-permission Actors can run other limited-permission Actors.
Prefer restricted MCP for interactive discovery and the explicit Actor API lifecycle for recurring jobs.
Starlight architecture is source-inspected; Apify connection, deployed enablement and real mission acceptance remain unproved.
